text:
You can cancel by deactivating your account, either in the Albert app or from a web browser at albert.com/deactivate. Deactivating cancels your subscription, but your login stays active so you can reactivate anytime.

Before you deactivate, bring your Albert Savings and Investing balances to $0 by withdrawing all funds and selling any investments. Deactivating also doesn't remove any advance or loan balances you owe, so you'll need to keep making those payments to avoid additional fees.
